Introduction
•In cloud -native applications , complex systems are broken into smaller, independent
units . •Functions  are the smallest deployable and executable unit of logic. •Instead of building huge monolithic applications, developers model business logic as
functions . •
This approach is event -driven, stateless, and cloud -managed .

Why Model as Functions? •Simplicity  → Focus only on “what function does,” not on infrastructure. •Reusability  → Same function can be used across services. •Scalability  → Functions scale independently. •Maintainability  → Easier debugging and updates. •Cost -efficiency  → Pay only when functions execute.
